# Keylight

> Keylight is a privacy-first, fully static DeepSeek API dashboard. It shows only data returned by DeepSeek's official API: account balance (`/user/balance`) and available models (`/models`). The user's API key stays in browser memory and is sent directly to `https://api.deepseek.com`; there is no backend, proxy, Worker, database, or analytics.

## Key facts

- Live site: the current origin.
- Source code: https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard
- Supported provider: DeepSeek only.
- Official endpoints used: `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` and `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`.
- The API key is never persisted by the site. Reloading the page clears it.
- The site does not expose Usage history, Account ID, plan, or account creation time because those are not in the current public DeepSeek API.
- Browser CORS preflight for both endpoints passed on 2026-10-26.
- The interface supports Chinese and English.
- No analytics, tracking SDKs, or error-reporting services are used.

## API key top-up

- The buyer chooses a USD amount on the PayPal-hosted checkout: https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/CMTG9BPF9Z2KG
- The estimated CNY API balance is: USD amount × reference USD/CNY rate × 100/95.
- The current UI reference rate is 1 USD = 6.68 CNY; the final rate and credit are confirmed on Telegram.
- After payment, the buyer joins the Telegram group for verification: https://t.me/+mErIcVI3_R4zMDE1
- After verification, the seller sends the API key by private message. The key is not displayed or stored by this website.
- This is a manual fulfillment flow, not an automatic PayPal discount.

## Limitations

- Keylight is not an official DeepSeek store and is not affiliated with DeepSeek.
- It cannot show data that the official API does not return.
- It cannot bypass browser CORS restrictions and will not add a proxy.
- The website cannot guarantee third-party payment, fulfillment, or Telegram delivery; buyers should verify the price, rate, and delivery with the seller.

## Contact

Use the Telegram link above for purchase support. Security issues without secrets can be reported at https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard/issues.
